primary_basis: Matthew 13:38 (explicit definition in the parable of the wheat and tares)

alternatives.meaning: the sphere or readiness of gospel harvest/evangelistic labor
the human heart or individual receptivity (soil types)
the church (as mixed community of wheat and tares)
basis: interpretive tradition applying Matthew 13:24-30 internally despite the explicit world identification

notes: Jesus’ own allegorical key in Matthew 13:38 supplies the dominant symbolic identification; other uses are secondary metaphors rather than competing primary symbols.
